g.text: 1. Tilt the marker nose-down, slide the top front edge under the lip, lower

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: the rear: its bottom edge runs down the 30° lead-in, pushes the latch

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: back by up to 1.36 mm (red, dotted) and the hook snaps over the top.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 2. The pads meet the free plungers (tip z 2.14, orange) at about 1.9° of tilt;

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: seated, the pins are compressed 1.14 of 2.29 mm.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 3. Release: press the thumb tab down; the pins lift the rear about

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 1.3 mm; lift the marker at the two finger scallops.

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 4. Check 7 poses the marker solids at 19 tilts from 17° to 0°: no

text.style: font-size: 5.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: interference with lip, nest walls, floor or pins.
